goal: Architecture overhaul and feature implementation for Drag-and-Drop Workflow Maker with Recurring Jobs and API Webhooks

tasks.title: Upgrade Password Storage from AES Encryption to Bcrypt Hashing
tasks.description: Replace vulnerable AES-GCM fixed-nonce password encryption in Server/crypto/crypto.go with standard secure Bcrypt hashing.
tasks.instruction:
1. Update Server/crypto/crypto.go to use golang.org/x/crypto/bcrypt for HashPassword and CompareHashAndPassword.
2. Refactor Database/users.go and Server/API.Methods.go Login and AddUser functions to use bcrypt verification.
3. Ensure database seed and user creation write hashed passwords.
tasks.verification: Run unit tests for user authentication and verify password comparison succeeds while raw text passwords cannot be decrypted.

tasks.title: Implement Webhook API Trigger Authentication and Secret Token Verification
tasks.description: Secure the public REST endpoint /api/webhook/{id} with mandatory secret header/query verification and optional HMAC payload signing.
tasks.instruction:
1. Add a WebhookSecret field to the Workflow definition in proto/workflow.proto and Database/workflows.go.
2. Update runWebhookHandler in Server/main.go to validate incoming headers (X-Webhook-Secret / X-Signature) against the workflow's configured secret.
3. Return HTTP 401 Unauthorized if secret validation fails.
tasks.verification: Test sending POST requests to /api/webhook/{id} with valid and invalid secret tokens, verifying invalid requests are rejected.

tasks.title: Hardening Input Validation and ReDoS Protection
tasks.description: Prevent Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS) and dangerous math expression execution in Math and Regex workflow nodes.
tasks.instruction:
1. Add timeout contexts and length limits to regex matching in ReplaceNodeProcess and FindAllNodeProcess in Server/workflow/workflow.node.process.go.
2. Restrict allowed syntax in Server/matheval to prevent unsafe expression evaluation.
tasks.verification: Pass long or complex expressions into Math and Regex nodes and verify execution safely times out without hanging the server.

tasks.title: Fix Critical Nil Pointer Dereference in HTTP API Node Processor
tasks.description: Fix server panic crash in makeRequest when HTTP client request returns an error before response headers are populated.
tasks.instruction:
1. In Server/workflow/workflow.helpers.go, move the err check immediately after client.Do(req).
2. Ensure response status code, headers, and length variables are set only when err == nil.
tasks.verification: Trigger an API node pointing to an invalid/unreachable URL (e.g. http://localhost:99999) and verify the node fails gracefully without crashing the server.

tasks.title: Fix Concurrent Data Race in Kafka Consumer Replay Data Flusher
tasks.description: Add thread-safe mutex synchronization to the global replayData slice in the Kafka consumer worker to prevent memory corruption.
tasks.instruction:
1. In Jobs/Consumer/main.go, wrap replayData slice access with a sync.Mutex in ConsumeClaim and the periodic flush goroutine.
2. Ensure atomic swap of the replay buffer during database batch writes.
tasks.verification: Run the Kafka consumer with `go run -race Jobs/Consumer/main.go` while executing high-volume parallel workflows to confirm zero data races.

tasks.title: Implement Atomic Redis SETNX Distributed Locking for Recurring Jobs
tasks.description: Replace race-prone check-then-set logic in interval job processing with atomic Redis distributed locking (SETNX with TTL).
tasks.instruction:
1. In Jobs/Interval/main.go, replace CacheExists followed by SetCache with an atomic SetNX / SetWithLock call in Database/cache.go.
2. Ensure only a single worker instance acquires the execution lock for a recurring job run.
tasks.verification: Run multiple instances of Jobs/Interval in parallel and verify recurring workflows are executed exactly once per interval.

tasks.title: Add Recursion Depth Limit and Cycle Detection for SubProcess Nodes
tasks.description: Prevent infinite recursion and stack overflow panics in SubProcessNodeProcess.
tasks.instruction:
1. Track call depth in WorkflowProcessor context (max depth e.g. 10).
2. Detect circular sub-process references (A calls B calls A) and return a clean execution error if maximum depth or cycle is detected.
tasks.verification: Create a sub-process workflow that references itself and verify it fails with a clear recursion depth exceeded error message.

tasks.title: Throttle Interval Job Polling Loop with Ticker and Cache Invalidation
tasks.description: Eliminate 100% CPU spinning and Postgres database hammering in Jobs/Interval by replacing infinite unthrottled loop with a controlled ticker.
tasks.instruction:
1. In Jobs/Interval/main.go, convert `for { DBCon.GetIntervalWorkflows() }` to use `ticker := time.NewTicker(5 * time.Second)`.
2. In Database/workflows.go, standardize interval cache keys and invalidate interval caches when a workflow is saved or deleted.
tasks.verification: Monitor CPU and database load while running Jobs/Interval and confirm near 0% idle CPU usage.

tasks.title: Pre-compile and Cache Workflow Templates for Fast Variable Substitution
tasks.description: Optimize populateTemplate in Server/workflow/workflow.helpers.go to reduce template compilation overhead during workflow execution.
tasks.instruction:
1. Implement template caching or fast regex/string variable substitution in WorkflowProcessor.
2. Reduce allocation overhead during node execution loops.
tasks.verification: Run quick-run benchmark on a 100-node workflow and verify reduced execution time.

tasks.title: Enhance Drag-and-Drop Workflow Canvas with Visual Node Builder and Palette
tasks.description: Refine the Vue Flow canvas interface in App/src/views/Workflow with drag-and-drop node sidebar, snap-to-grid alignment, category search filtering, and node connection validation.
tasks.instruction:
1. Update Canvas and Sidebar components in App/src/views/Workflow.
2. Add interactive node palette with categorization (Triggers, Logic, Actions, Data).
3. Enhance visual handle connections and node status indicators.
tasks.verification: Verify dragging nodes from sidebar onto canvas, connecting handles, and configuring node data in the UI.

tasks.title: Build Dedicated Recurring Job (Scheduler) Node and Modal Configuration
tasks.description: Provide a rich UI editor for recurring jobs supporting interval presets (seconds, minutes, hours, days), day-of-week selection, and next run preview.
tasks.instruction:
1. Create IntervalNode.vue component and interval configuration panel.
2. Allow users to configure intervals, active days of the week, and enable/disable schedules.
3. Display active schedule status badge on the workflow list and builder header.
tasks.verification: Create a recurring workflow in the UI, set it to run every 10 seconds, and observe execution logs triggering automatically.

tasks.title: Build Webhook API Trigger Endpoint Generator and cURL Exporter UI
tasks.description: Add a dedicated Webhook Trigger Node UI with auto-generated trigger URLs, secret token manager, sample JSON payload builder, and cURL snippet generator.
tasks.instruction:
1. Update WebhookNode component with interactive endpoint URL generator (`http://localhost:8082/api/webhook/{workflow_id}`).
2. Provide copyable cURL command snippet with custom headers and body sample.
3. Add a 'Test Trigger' button in the builder to trigger the webhook directly.
tasks.verification: Click 'Test Trigger' or paste the cURL command into a terminal and verify the workflow executes in real-time.
